apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1

---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service

spec:

  ports:
    - port: 443
      targetPort: 8443
      protocol: TCP
  selector:
    k8s-app: kubernetes-dashboard
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: kubernetes-dashboard
  namespace: kubernetes-dashboard
  labels:
    k8s-app: kubernetes-dashboard
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      k8s-app: kubernetes-dashboard
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        k8s-app: kubernetes-dashboard
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: kubernetes-dashboard
      containers:
        - name: kubernetes-dashboard
          image: kubernetesui/dashboard:v2.7.0
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8443
              protocol: TCP
          args:
            - --auto-generate-certificates
            - --namespace=kubernetes-dashboard
            - --metrics-provider=sidecar
            - --api-log-level=INFO
            - --token-ttl=900
            - --authentication-mode=token
            - --enable-insecure-login=false
            - --enable-skip-login=false
            - --disable-settings-authorizer=false
            - --system-banner-severity=INFO
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 1001
            runAsGroup: 2001
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 8443
              schemes:
                - HTTPS
            initialDelayPeriod: 30
            period: 10
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 8443
              schemes:
                - HTTPS
            initialDelayPeriod: 30
            period: 10
          resources:
            request:
              cpu: 100m
              memory: 30Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 300m
              memory: 100Mi
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnly: true
            runAsUser: 1001
            runAsGroup: 2001
          imagePullPolicy: Always
      securityContext:
        runAsNonPrivileged: true
        runAsUser: 1001
        runAsGroup: 2001
        seccompprofile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      tolerations:
        - key: "CriticalAddonsOnly"
          operator: "Exists"
